incarnation: Nova Vey — selected universal4x8pack / current original project design

references.note: Shared source gained unrelated corrected hero selections during production; the Nova selected pack lines are unchanged. This exact inspected excerpt is retained as stable documentary evidence.

visualLocks.hair: Short silver/grey asymmetric bob; longer fringe hides one eye. Never historical dark-haired male design.
visualLocks.face: Youth-neutral fair face as selected sprite; visible cyan reading monocle, anatomical side unresolved at this sprite resolution.
visualLocks.costume: Long split navy technical coat, closed black/navy bodysuit, dark chest and knee/shin plates, cyan seams, black gloves and boots. No helmet.
visualLocks.equipment: One long cyan-lit black/metal resonance staff ending in two parallel open U prongs; no rectangular screen-head staff from historical atlas, no rifle, no shield or card deck.
visualLocks.palette: Primary navy#153b55 and cyan#7df9ff, silver hair, black protective suit; modest copper/ivory environmental accents only.
visualLocks.anatomy: One human body/head, two arms/two legs, ordinary five-finger gloved hands where visible.
visualLocks.personality: Precise mobile possibility analyst. Measures causal routes without predicting certain futures or imposing her preferred choice.
visualLocks.distinction: Nova reads possibilities with monocle/diapason; she is not Mirelle with cards/sutures, Bastion with heavy shield/gun, or the player Anchor commander.

equipment: Cyan scanning monocle (side not canonically established)
